newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices lower on dull export demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices lower on dull export demand.

text.p: Indian castor prices fell on Monday on dull export demand and liquidation ahead of new crop arrivals, dealers said.
Groundnut oil fell to 410/412 rupees per 10 kg from 416/418 rupees on sluggish physical buying and new crops.
"Availability of other edible oils including palm oil at cheaper levels also dragged down groundnut prices," one dealer said. Delivery after a week was quoted at 402/404 rupees.
Rajkot spot oil fell by 10/15 to 550 rupees per 15 kg.
"Gujarat authorities have disallowed sale of groundnut oil out of the state and millers there are facing a glut," he said.
